rounds.q: What % of Earth's surface is covered by water?
rounds.why: And about 96.5% of all Earth's water is in the oceans.
rounds.fun: Earth is 71% wet. Maybe we should have named it Planet Ocean!

rounds.q: What % of Earth's land area is covered by forest?
rounds.why: Primary forest that's never been logged makes up about a third of that.
rounds.fun: About a third of Earth's land is forest. Plenty of room for hide and seek!

rounds.q: What % of Earth's fresh water is frozen in ice and glaciers?
rounds.why: Groundwater holds about another 30%. Rivers and lakes are a tiny sliver.
rounds.fun: Most of Earth's fresh water is frozen solid. Our planet keeps its drinks on ice!

rounds.q: What % of the ocean floor has been mapped in detail?
rounds.why: That mapped area is still bigger than two-thirds of all the land on Earth.
rounds.fun: Only 29% of the sea floor is mapped in detail. Explorers, grab your pencils!

rounds.q: What % of the world's electricity came from renewables in 2025?
rounds.why: That edged past coal's 33%, the first time in 100 years renewables beat coal.
rounds.fun: Renewables 34, coal 33. First win in 100 years, by just one point. Photo finish!
